_about: Mock gateway stages, review clocks and product weaknesses for the review simulator. Clocks are simplified teaching models of the public procedures; all products, questions and answers are fictional.

US.label: Gateway receipt
US.detail: The transmission arrived and the package checksum matched.

US.label: Routed to the review centre
US.detail: The package was delivered to the centre that reviews this application.

US.label: Technical validation and load
US.detail: Validation against the technical rules; a High finding rejects the sequence.

EU.label: Gateway receipt
EU.detail: The transmission arrived and the package checksum matched.

EU.label: Routed to the agency
EU.detail: The envelope was read and the sequence routed to the procedure.

EU.label: Technical validation (pass or fail)
EU.detail: A failed criterion makes the sequence technically invalid.

JP.label: Receipt of the submission unit
JP.detail: The unit arrived and its SHA-256 checksums matched.

JP.label: Technical validation
JP.detail: The submission unit message and files are validated; an error stops the unit.

IN.label: Upload received
IN.detail: The files were uploaded to the online portal.

IN.label: Form and fee check
IN.detail: The application form and fee receipt were found.

IN.label: Screening
IN.detail: The dossier was screened for completeness before review.

rejection.US: Correct the problem and resubmit the sequence. This app reopens it with the same sequence number.
rejection.EU: The EU harmonised technical guidance says a technically invalid sequence is not accepted, and the corrected sequence is resubmitted with the same sequence number.
rejection.JP: Correct the problem and resubmit the unit. This app reopens it with the same unit number.
rejection.IN: Upload the missing items. This app reopens the upload as a draft.

US.label: US review clock (NME NDA or BLA, standard review)

milestones.label: Application received
milestones.help: The review clock starts on receipt of an accepted original application.

milestones.label: Filing decision
milestones.help: The agency decides within 60 days whether the application is complete enough to review. A seriously incomplete one is refused (refuse to file).

milestones.label: Day-74 letter: review issues
milestones.help: Issues found during the filing review are sent to the applicant. Information requests can follow at any time; the clock keeps running.

milestones.label: Mid-cycle communication
milestones.help: The review team tells the applicant about significant issues so far.

milestones.label: Action on the goal date
milestones.help: For a new molecular entity under standard review the goal is 10 months after the 60-day filing date. The outcome is an approval letter or a complete response letter.

US.negative: Complete response letter issued: the application cannot be approved in its present form.

EU.label: EU centralised procedure clock

milestones.label: Procedure starts
milestones.help: The clock starts after validation of the application.

milestones.label: Day 120 list of questions
milestones.help: The committee adopts the list of questions. The clock stops until the applicant responds (usually up to 3 months, extendable).

milestones.label: Day 180 list of outstanding issues
milestones.help: Issues not resolved by the responses. The clock stops again; an oral explanation can follow.

milestones.label: Day 210 opinion
milestones.help: The committee adopts its opinion. The European Commission decision follows within 67 days.

EU.positive: Positive opinion adopted; the Commission decision follows.
EU.negative: Major objections remain: in practice the applicant faces a negative opinion or withdraws.

JP.label: Japan review timeline (new active ingredient, standard review)

milestones.label: Application received
milestones.help: The review starts on receipt of the first submission unit.

milestones.label: First inquiries
milestones.help: The reviewers send inquiries. The applicant answers, often with revised documents in a new unit.

milestones.label: Further inquiries
milestones.help: Points still open after the first answers.

milestones.label: Expert discussion
milestones.help: The review team discusses the conclusions with external experts.

milestones.label: Decision
milestones.help: The target total review time for standard review is about 12 months.

JP.negative: Approval not granted: inquiries remain unresolved.

IN.label: India new drug application clock (working days)

milestones.label: Application received
milestones.help: The clock counts working days from receipt.

milestones.label: Query letter
milestones.help: Deficiencies are sent to the applicant, who answers with a query response.

milestones.label: Decision
milestones.help: The rules set a decision within 90 working days for a new drug already approved in another country.

IN.negative: Application rejected; the reasons are given in writing and the applicant may appeal.

nce-tablet.text: The dissolution method has not been shown to discriminate between batches made with different drug substance particle sizes. Provide data showing the method is discriminating.
nce-tablet.fixTitle: Pharmaceutical Development (updated: discriminating power of the dissolution method)
nce-tablet.answer: Dissolution profiles of batches made with fine, nominal and coarse drug substance are provided; the method separates them (f2 below 50 for the coarse batch).

nce-tablet.text: Only 6 months of long-term stability data are provided for the registration batches. Provide the 12-month data.
nce-tablet.answer: 12-month long-term and 6-month accelerated data for the three registration batches are provided; all results are within specification.

nce-tablet.text: Provide an analysis of efficacy and safety by baseline renal function across the phase 3 studies.
nce-tablet.fixTitle: Integrated Analysis of Efficacy and Safety by Renal Function
nce-tablet.answer: The pooled analysis shows a consistent effect across renal function categories; no dose adjustment is proposed for mild or moderate impairment.

generic-tablet.text: Provide comparative dissolution data against the reference product at pH 1.2, 4.5 and 6.8.
generic-tablet.fixTitle: Pharmaceutical Development (updated: comparative dissolution in three media)
generic-tablet.answer: Comparative profiles at pH 1.2, 4.5 and 6.8 are provided; f2 is above 50 in all media.

generic-tablet.text: The limit for an unspecified degradation product is above the qualification threshold. Justify the limit or tighten it.
generic-tablet.answer: The limit has been tightened to the qualification threshold; the revised specification is provided.

sterile-injectable.text: Provide container closure integrity data for the vial and stopper over the proposed shelf life.
sterile-injectable.answer: Deterministic container closure integrity testing at release and end of shelf life is provided; all units passed.

sterile-injectable.text: Provide the media fill and filter validation data supporting the aseptic process.
sterile-injectable.fixTitle: Process Validation (aseptic process: media fills and filter validation)
sterile-injectable.answer: Three consecutive media fills with no contaminated units and the bacterial retention study for the sterilising filter are provided.

mab-infusion.text: Provide viral clearance data for the low-pH hold step, including the effect of hold time.
mab-infusion.fixTitle: Adventitious Agents Safety Evaluation (updated: low-pH viral clearance)
mab-infusion.answer: Viral clearance studies at the minimum hold time and pH are provided; the step gives robust clearance of enveloped viruses.

mab-infusion.text: Provide characterisation of the acidic and basic charge variants, including their potency.
mab-infusion.fixTitle: Elucidation of Structure (updated: charge variant characterisation)
mab-infusion.answer: Isolated charge variant fractions were characterised; all retain binding and potency within the range of the main peak.

mab-infusion.text: Provide validation of the anti-drug antibody assay, including drug tolerance.
mab-infusion.fixTitle: Validation of the Anti-Drug Antibody Assay
mab-infusion.answer: The validation report is provided; the assay detects 100 ng/mL of positive control in the presence of expected trough drug levels.

biosimilar-mab.text: The afucosylated glycan level is higher than in the reference product. Discuss its effect on FcγRIIIa binding and ADCC.
biosimilar-mab.fixTitle: Elucidation of Structure (updated: afucosylation and ADCC)
biosimilar-mab.answer: FcγRIIIa binding and ADCC fall within the reference product range; the difference has no effect on the mechanism of action.

biosimilar-mab.text: Justify extrapolation to the indications not studied in the comparative clinical study.
biosimilar-mab.answer: The mechanism of action, receptors and target tissues are the same across indications; analytical and clinical similarity supports extrapolation.
